gateway.title: Gateway
gateway.proxyDesc: Route Electron and Gateway traffic through your local proxy client.
gateway.proxyServerHelp: The default proxy for all requests. Bare host:port values default to HTTP.
gateway.proxyHttpServerHelp: Advanced override for HTTP requests. Leave blank to use Proxy Server.
gateway.proxyHttpsServerHelp: Advanced override for HTTPS requests. Leave blank to use Proxy Server.
gateway.proxyAllServerHelp: Advanced fallback for SOCKS-capable clients and protocols such as Telegram. Leave blank to use Proxy Server.
gateway.proxyBypassHelp: Semicolon, comma, or newline separated hosts that should connect directly.
gateway.proxyRestartNote: Saving reapplies Electron networking and restarts the Gateway immediately. Regular Gateway restarts keep existing Telegram channel proxy values when proxy is disabled; save while disabled to clear them.

advanced.title: Advanced
advanced.devModeDesc: Show advanced settings for diagnostics, gateway proxy, telemetry, and Doctor
advanced.promptOptimizationDesc: Apply lossless prompt compression to LLM requests and show saved characters at the bottom of each turn. LLM dump files are written only when Developer Mode is also enabled. Restart the Gateway to apply changes.
advanced.autoWorkflowDesc: When on, a single-agent turn that reads like a multi-step task may automatically be broken into a workflow. Off by default — leave it off to always get a normal chat reply.
advanced.telemetryDesc: Allow providing anonymous basic usage data to improve $t(common:appName)
advanced.sessionMaintenanceDesc: Configure session.maintenance in openclaw.json. Session transcripts under the agents directory are append-only and can reach several GB; Enforce lets the Gateway prune old/over-budget sessions automatically. Leave a field blank to use the OpenClaw default.
advanced.sessionMaintenanceHint: Mode defaults to Enforce so the Gateway prunes on its own schedule. Set Warn to disable automatic deletion. Blank fields fall back to OpenClaw defaults.
advanced.farmApiBearerTokenDesc: Admin JWT for your YYClaw server (same as web console). Used for skill publish over WebSocket to /api/v1/admin/workspace-skills/upload-ws.
